info.title: API.SH: Kijiji
info.description: The Kijiji API from API.SH: public Kijiji data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Kijiji's category tree one level at a time: the subcategories of a category with their ids, listing counts (in the chosen location) and browse links, and the path above it. Category ids work as the category of `/kijiji/v1/search`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kijiji-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A Kijiji category id (0 for all categories, 10 Buy & Sell, 27 Cars & Vehicles, 34 Real Estate, ...). Default 0.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A Kijiji location id for the counts (0 for Canada). Default 0.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Kijiji ad: price, full description, every attribute, photos, location, posting and end dates, views, category path and, for business sellers, the business profile (name, website, logo, listing count, address). Pass `id`, `url`, or `latest=1` with search params (`q`, `location_id`, `category`, ...). Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kijiji-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kijiji's location tree one level at a time: the provinces of Canada, the regions of a province or the areas of a region, with their ids, listing counts and browse links, and the path above. Location ids work as the location of `/kijiji/v1/search`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kijiji-locations

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A Kijiji location id (0 for Canada, 9004 Ontario, 1700272 Toronto (GTA), ...) or a kijiji.ca browse link. Default 0.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A Kijiji category id for the counts. Default 0 (all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kijiji (Canada) classified ads for a keyword, category and location, with price, radius around a point, seller type, price type and sort. Each result has price, photos, location, posting date, attributes and flags; `filters` lists every category, location and attribute value the site offers for the search (use their ids), `top_ads` the promoted ads. 40 per page. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kijiji-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Kijiji category id (10 Buy & Sell, 27 Cars & Vehicles, 37 Real Estate, 644 Bikes, 760 Cell phones); see `filters`. Default 0 = all.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Kijiji location id (0 Canada, 9004 Ontario, 1700273 City of Toronto, 1700281 Montreal, 1700287 Vancouver); see `filters`.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for a radius search (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude for a radius search (with lat).

parameters.name: price_type
parameters.description: Only free, contact-for-price or swap/trade ads.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Category attribute filters as name:value, comma-separated (names from `results[].attributes`, e.g. phonebrand:apple).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
